title: bluetooth issues
body:
Hi there, I am using the latest version (2020.01.26) with Miao Miao 2.

It has been running on and off during the last days, let me say that I started with the CGM since last Friday, but I was not able to keep the app running for more than... let me say more than 5 hours.
I tried with all the bluethooth settings (Less common settings -> Bluetooth settings -> Disable Trust Android Auto Connect... and many other setting that I have been reading in some other posts) but nothing is working.

Right now on System status I see this on **"Classic Status Page"**:
Bluetooth Device: None Set
Connection status: Not connected
On **"BT Device"**:
Bluetooth Device: Disconnecting
Bluethooth Pairing: Not bonded

I could fix the issue with the connection few times by clicking on the "**Not bonded**" message, the it changes to "**Disabled, tap to enable**", then I was clicking again on it and there was a message down on the screen saying "_This probably only works on HM10/HM11 and blucon devices at the moment and takes a minute_"

Sometimes it works, but now I lost the connection since 3-4 hours ago and it doesn't work anymore.

I am waiting for the next release to see if I can fix it by installing the new version but I think there are many people with this issues... 

On the other hand, let me say that the readings were not very trustable during these 2-3 days. I found differences about 50-60 mg/dL in many occasions. I was always calibrating hoping that the next reading would be more accurate but no, a couple of hours later again there were big difference between the reading and the BG, is that normal?

Sorry for this long message but I have been even thinking about giving back the device.

any help will be appreciated. Thank you!
